title: Ladies Cigar Event | Ugly Christmas Sweater Edition
seo_title: Ladies Cigar Event: Ugly Christmas Sweater in Ozark, MO
description: This is a Ladies Cigar Event with a holiday twist, held in the lounge, where guests wear tacky Christmas sweaters, smoke Padron cigars, and sip Kevin's Cocktails. It is for ladies, and the ticket is $45. It takes place Wednesday, December 9, 2026 at 6:00 PM at Vineyard Market, 1759 W State Hwy J in Ozark, MO.
